name: command-center.setpoint-read
purpose: Read external binding condition and outcome-linked preparation learning; retain absent baselines and operator usefulness telemetry as explicit gaps.
assumptions: Source owners independently report unavailable evidence.
invariants: No empty learning cohort is reported as successful.
Targets are never derived from current readings.

signals.rows: binding-health, learning, external-friction, briefing-quality, operator-usefulness; each has reading, target, in_band, unavailable and reason.

budget.async_reason: Independent peer instruments may require slow owner reads; runner waits once.

fixtures.note: Partial only when external reads fail; unmeasured permanent rows do not lower status.
